 2026 NBA odds, picks, predictions, best bets, player props: Experts, model backing Heat, more on Oct. 21
 SportsLine's experts and the SportsLine Projection Model have revealed NBA picks and best bets for Wednesday, October 21
 By
 Owen OBrien 
 Oct 21, 2026
 at
 5:57 pm ET 
 •
 3 min read
 Add CBS Sports on Google 
 After a three-game slate for the NBA Opening Night, the 2026-27 NBA season continues with an 11-game slate on Wednesday. Tonight's matchups include Timberwolves vs. Heat at 7:30 p.m. ET, Jazz vs. Grizzlies at 8 p.m. ET and Warriors vs. Lakers at 10 p.m. ET. The SportsLine Projection Model is backing Giannis Antetokounmpo's Miami era to begin well, backing the Heat to cover as 1.5-point favorites as part of NBA best bets on Wednesday. Antetokounmpo's Over/Under for total points in his Heat debut is 28.5, and he's priced at +406 to record a triple-double. The SportsLine team of experts has also locked in NBA best bets, including player prop betting picks on Grizzlies vs. Jazz and Lakers vs. Warriors.  Heat (-1.5) vs. Timberwolves (-108)
 Darryn Peterson, Jazz, Over 16.5 Total points + assists (-117)

 Heat (-1.5) vs. Timberwolves (-108)
 The Miami Heat missed the playoffs last year for the first time in seven years, losing in the Play-In Tournament despite having a winning record at 43-39. Miami was especially strong at home last season, going 26-15. This year, the Heat added Giannis Antetokounmpo, a two-time NBA MVP and 10-time All-Star who averaged at least 29.9 points per game in four straight seasons before last year's injury-plagued campaign. With Giannis' addition, along with veterans Klay Thompson and Tim Hardaway Jr., the model projects the Heat cover in 59% of simulations.  Get $200 in bonus bets and three free months of NBA League Pass after your first $5 bet at DraftKings :
 Darryn Peterson, Jazz, Over 16.5 Total points + assists (-117)
 "This line is underselling Darryn Peterson's role for the Jazz on opening night," SportsLine expert Prop Bet Guy Doug said. "The rookie will be thrown into the starting lineup, likely splitting on-ball duties with Keyonte George. This should be a game where Peterson's ability to get to the bucket and mid-range game plays well against a Grizzlies team that's weak defensively on the perimeter and plays fast. After a strong finish to the preseason, I like the rookie to start fast out of the gate."  Claim the Fanatics Sportsbook promo code CBSFAN350 to get $350 in FanCash: 
 Yaxel Lendeborg, Warriors, Over 24.5 points + rebounds + assists (-120)
 "Yaxel Lendeborg won Summer League MVP and continued his strong play throughout the preseason, averaging 15.6 points, 8.2 rebounds and 4.2 assists," SportsLine expert Larry Hartstein said. "He will start for the Warriors and likely play heavy minutes due to the absences of Jimmy Butler, Kristaps Porzingis and Moses Moody. In two preseason matchups with the Lakers, the 24-year-old Lendeborg averaged 17 points, seven rebounds and three assists in 23 minutes.
